If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *North Studio* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:46b6964c, email:eaa9033b). No tickets, so no signal of active use at all. Silent, fully inactive Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Checking in now that you're a week into Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one is usually the quickest way to see how the pieces fit. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
